_comment: PLACEHOLDER numbers for dry runs and tests, not measurements. The SGLang 0.5.21 pilot of Qwen3-8B; a cell may only use a pilot of its own engine (orchestrate.py refuses another). The pilot overwrites every value: arm_rss_bytes per arm label as the peak RSS of that arm's processes beyond its pinned host tier, sidecar_rss_bytes as the live-scoring sidecar's peak RSS (added to arm K's memory.max), prefill_tok_s and wt_offered_write_Bps as SGLang's measured prefill rate and HC-wt's offered L3 write rate at each load.
